# Real Deflate64 archive

`zipfile-deflate64.zip` is the test archive of [brianhelba/zipfile-deflate64](https://github.com/brianhelba/zipfile-deflate64),
`tests/data/deflate64.zip`, Apache-2.0. Its four entries are compressed with method 9 (Deflate64): `100_lines.txt`,
`100k_lines.txt`, `10_lines.txt` and `10k_lines.txt`. It is stored with Git LFS in that repository; this copy is the LFS
content (165,748 bytes), fetched from `media.githubusercontent.com`.
